name: ScatterAdd16
adaptation: Start from 16 signed INT16 cells. Apply eight updates, indices unsigned four-bit lanes, updates signed INT16 lanes. Output cell j equals in_data[j]+sum(in_updates[i] for i with index[i]=j), reduced modulo 2^16. All duplicate indices contribute; unaddressed cells are unchanged. Return the entire 16-cell result. INT16 modular overflow is explicit.
